# vktSpvAsmMaint9VectorizationTests

## Overview

Tests for [`VK_KHR_maintenance9`](../../../modules/vulkan/spirv_assembly/vktSpvAsmMaint9VectorizationTests.cpp#L292-L294) bitwise operation vectorization, verifying SPIR-V bitwise operations with non-32-bit operand types and mixed scalar/vector configurations generated by [`createMaint9VectorizationTests`](../../../modules/vulkan/spirv_assembly/vktSpvAsmMaint9VectorizationTests.cpp#L1291-L1415). Uses buffer device addresses to prevent shader compiler scalarization ([source](../../../modules/vulkan/spirv_assembly/vktSpvAsmMaint9VectorizationTests.cpp#L299-L305)).

## Role

Implementation file

## Test Families

### bit_count — Tests OpBitCount with various operand types

Tests `OpBitCount` across all combinations of: scalar vs. vec4, 8/16/32/64-bit base types, signed/unsigned, and result bit widths (8/16/32/64). The result type may differ from the base type. Source: [registration loops](../../../modules/vulkan/spirv_assembly/vktSpvAsmMaint9VectorizationTests.cpp#L1296-L1314).

### bit_reverse — Tests OpBitReverse with various operand types

Tests `OpBitReverse` across all combinations of: scalar vs. vec4, 8/16/32/64-bit types, signed/unsigned. Result type must match base type. Source: [registration loops](../../../modules/vulkan/spirv_assembly/vktSpvAsmMaint9VectorizationTests.cpp#L1316-L1334).

### bit_field_insert — Tests OpBitFieldInsert with various operand types

Tests `OpBitFieldInsert` across all combinations of: scalar vs. vec4 base, 8/16/32/64-bit base/insert types, 8/16/32/64-bit offset and count types, and signedness variations for each operand. Offset and count are always scalar. Source: [registration loops](../../../modules/vulkan/spirv_assembly/vktSpvAsmMaint9VectorizationTests.cpp#L1336-L1361).

### bit_field_s_extract — Tests OpBitFieldSExtract with various operand types

Tests `OpBitFieldSExtract` (signed extraction) across all combinations of: scalar vs. vec4 base, 8/16/32/64-bit base types, 8/16/32/64-bit offset and count types, and signedness variations. Source: [registration loops](../../../modules/vulkan/spirv_assembly/vktSpvAsmMaint9VectorizationTests.cpp#L1363-L1387).

### bit_field_u_extract — Tests OpBitFieldUExtract with various operand types

Tests `OpBitFieldUExtract` (unsigned extraction) with the same parameter space as bit_field_s_extract. Source: [registration loops](../../../modules/vulkan/spirv_assembly/vktSpvAsmMaint9VectorizationTests.cpp#L1389-L1413).

## Parameter Dimensions

| Dimension | Values | Description |
|-----------|--------|-------------|
| Bit operation | COUNT, REVERSE, INSERT, S_EXTRACT, U_EXTRACT | The SPIR-V bitwise operation |
| Vectorness | scalar, vec4 | Whether operands are scalar or 4-component vectors |
| Bit size | 8, 16, 32, 64 | Bit width of each operand type |
| Signedness | signed, unsigned | Whether each operand is signed or unsigned |
| Operand role | result, base, insert, offset, count | Role of each operand in the operation |

## Support Requirements

- [Vulkan 1.3](../../../modules/vulkan/spirv_assembly/vktSpvAsmMaint9VectorizationTests.cpp#L286-L290) (uses [SPIR-V 1.6](../../../modules/vulkan/spirv_assembly/vktSpvAsmMaint9VectorizationTests.cpp#L713-L716) build options)
- [`VK_KHR_maintenance9`](../../../modules/vulkan/spirv_assembly/vktSpvAsmMaint9VectorizationTests.cpp#L292-L294) when required by the operand parameters
- [`bufferDeviceAddress`](../../../modules/vulkan/spirv_assembly/vktSpvAsmMaint9VectorizationTests.cpp#L299-L301) feature (Vulkan 1.2)
- [`scalarBlockLayout`](../../../modules/vulkan/spirv_assembly/vktSpvAsmMaint9VectorizationTests.cpp#L303-L305) feature (Vulkan 1.2)
- [`shaderInt64`](../../../modules/vulkan/spirv_assembly/vktSpvAsmMaint9VectorizationTests.cpp#L307-L310) for 64-bit types
- [`shaderInt16`](../../../modules/vulkan/spirv_assembly/vktSpvAsmMaint9VectorizationTests.cpp#L311-L312) for 16-bit types
- [`shaderInt8`](../../../modules/vulkan/spirv_assembly/vktSpvAsmMaint9VectorizationTests.cpp#L314-L315) + [`storageBuffer8BitAccess`](../../../modules/vulkan/spirv_assembly/vktSpvAsmMaint9VectorizationTests.cpp#L321-L322) for 8-bit types
- [`storageBuffer16BitAccess`](../../../modules/vulkan/spirv_assembly/vktSpvAsmMaint9VectorizationTests.cpp#L317-L319) for 16-bit types

## Verification Methods

The [`M9V_Instance::iterate()`](../../../modules/vulkan/spirv_assembly/vktSpvAsmMaint9VectorizationTests.cpp#L1137-L1285) method:
1. Generates pseudorandom operand values for each workgroup invocation (64 invocations)
2. For INSERT/S_EXTRACT/U_EXTRACT, constrains offset and count to valid ranges
3. Computes expected results using CPU reference functions (`singleBitCount`, `singleBitReverse`, `singleBitFieldInsert`, `singleBitFieldExtract`)
4. Compares GPU output against CPU reference, reporting mismatches with operation details

## Notes

- Uses [`PhysicalStorageBufferAddresses`](../../../modules/vulkan/spirv_assembly/vktSpvAsmMaint9VectorizationTests.cpp#L340-L342) (buffer device addresses) to pass operand buffers indirectly, preventing shader compiler scalarization on some implementations ([source](../../../modules/vulkan/spirv_assembly/vktSpvAsmMaint9VectorizationTests.cpp#L1147-L1155))
- SPIR-V 1.6 assembly is generated at runtime using [`SpirVAsmBuildOptions`](../../../modules/vulkan/spirv_assembly/vktSpvAsmMaint9VectorizationTests.cpp#L713-L716) with `SPIRV_VERSION_1_6`
- Test names encode operand types, e.g., `result_s32i-base_s32i` for signed 32-bit scalar OpBitCount
